notes: CRM notes - Lodestar is a regulated fintech payments platform evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) to replace an in-house inference stack. Primary constraints: MUST keep customer PII and transaction vectors in EU. Requires SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning for automated user/group sync. RBAC must be configurable in Redwood console/control-plane: separate admin, ops, reviewer roles; no cross-tenant admin access. KMS integration mandatory: BYOK with HSM-backed keys and key rotation policy; also need proof of key usage audit. Audit logs retention 7 years (legal requirement) and ability to forward logs to their Splunk/GCP logging. Performance targets: p95 latency < 120ms for 512-token chat requests at steady 200 req/s; throughput burst to 600 req/s during peak. Model preference: quantized 70B for core risk models, fallback to 13B for less-sensitive routes. Quote from Head of Infra: "We will not accept any control plane accounts outside EU region; SCIM groups -> RBAC mapping is a blocker." Next steps: legal/security addendum, KMS integration workshop (infra + security), SCIM attributes test matrix. POC scope constrained to one EU VPC, 2-week KMS PoC, SCIM sync with Azure AD, RBAC role mapping in console.
